source.note: Substitutes for the plan's Quaternius fridge (poly.pizza static GLB, blocked by a Cloudflare challenge). Kenney Furniture Kit 2.0 `kitchenFridge` (GLB): an upright two-door fridge, freezer door on top, two bar handles, a recessed kick plate and a condenser panel on the back. Chosen over the kit's other fridges for a Japanese apartment kitchen: `kitchenFridgeLarge` is a US side-by-side with an ice dispenser (2.55 m tall at this scale), `kitchenFridgeSmall` an under-counter cube (1.16 m), `kitchenFridgeBuiltIn` the same fridge boxed into a wood cabinet. Kept at the kit's own scale, the same as sofa, TV and desk-teacher (0.384 kit units = 0.74 m): 1.77 m tall, 0.83 m wide, 0.56 m deep. A debug render placed the source materials: body and doors `metalLight`, handles `metal`, the back condenser panel `metalDark` (here the names match their look, unlike the TV); `glass` is not visible from outside and goes with the body. The body takes the pale paper pair (practical, sky shade), so the front door face reads cream and the sides white; the handles and the back panel are the script's dark brown (`iris`) in one tone. Front (doors) faces +Z, handles on the right (+X). Static, no clips.
